independence.notes: No Claude obligation is pending. Source-faithful reintegration remains the protected whole-product evaluation substrate. The current gate is human review of one unselected resting angled right-side rail at ?edge=angled. The rail's spatial identity must be present in the compact resting state through angle, perspective, visible thickness and Cockpit-edge attachment. Optional expansion exists only to reveal labels and must not create or intensify the 3D identity. Research 092 and Research 093 drag variants remain historical evidence and are not an active comparison requirement. The complete browser gate passed 64/64 at implementation target 67c3105ff26601a2f259e44007b23ce638b23838. Production /cockpit remains untouched.

last_transition.reason: The project owner clarified that the desired spatial / 3D quality belongs to the right-side bar itself at rest rather than to pull/deployment behavior. Research 094 and Checkpoint 254 replace the active A/B/C drag comparison with one resting angled rail whose optional expansion is only for label clarity. The complete Cockpit gate passed 64/64 while preserving all accepted mechanisms.
